title: Practice 1: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Диван в ___ (лифт, acc. sg.) не влезет.
exercises.prompt: The couch won't fit in the elevator.
exercises.why: **лифт → лифт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. лифт · лифта · лифту · лифт · лифтом · лифте; pl. лифты · лифтов · лифтам · лифты · лифтами · лифтах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Экран моего телефона перестал реагировать на ___ (нажатие, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: My phone screen stopped responding to presses.
exercises.why: **нажатие → нажатия** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural нажатия; declines like DLI's батареи (vowel stem): A. батареи. Ending -е → -я.  Declension: sg. нажатие · нажатия · нажатию · нажатие · нажатием · нажатии; pl. нажатия · нажатий · нажатиям · нажатия · нажатиями · нажатиях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Этна извергнулась, отправляя лаву и пепел в ___ (сицилийское небо, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Mount Etna has erupted, sending lava and ash plumes into the Sicilian sky.
exercises.why: **небо → небо** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о — declines like DLI's окно: A. окно. Ending -о → -о.  **сицилийский → сицилийское** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with небо). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ое → -ое.  Declension: sg. небо · неба · небу · небо · небом · небе; pl. небеса · небес · небесам · небеса · небесами · небесах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том отнёс два ящика в ___ (кладовая, acc. sg.) комнату.
exercises.prompt: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
exercises.why: **кладовая → кладовую** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я — declines like DLI's тётя: A. тётю. Ending -я → -ую (the stem changes: кладов-). The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я ходила на ___ (твой сайт, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I went to your website.
exercises.why: **сайт → сайт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **твой → твой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with сайт). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой / наш. Ending -й → -й.  Declension: sg. сайт · сайта · сайту · сайт · сайтом · сайте; pl. сайты · сайтов · сайтам · сайты · сайтами · сайтах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Чувство юмора сослужит вам хорошую службу в ___ (трудное время, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: A sense of humour will stand you in good stead in difficult times.
exercises.why: **время → времена** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural времена; declines like DLI's словари (soft stem): A. словари. Ending -я → -ена.  **трудный → трудные** (acc. pl., agreeing with времена). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новые: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ые → -ые.  Declension: sg. время · времени · времени · время · временем · времени; pl. времена · времён · временам · времена · временами · временах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
